decisions.reason: As a multi-item supplement range launched with its own page and close to the firm's stated consumer-health expansion, management would still tend to persist despite the lack of later website evidence.
This visibly promoted skin-and-hair supplement fits the portfolio-broadening strategy, so prior launch commitment still slightly outweighs the concern created by its later non-observation.
Because this joint-health supplement had lower initial visibility and was not observed later, management has less public commitment to defend and is more likely to reallocate resources.
This niche mushroom-based immune supplement had the weakest visibility and strategic weight, so after several years without observation even an escalation-prone management is likely to let it go.

For the generic blood-pressure medicine, sunk regulatory and launch costs are substantial and the earlier setback can still be framed as a temporary quality issue rather than a reason to abandon the product.

The OTC migraine triptan was launched recently enough and with standalone presentation that management would usually continue backing it, especially since the missing later web archives are not clear evidence of failure.
